The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an ¿I can do that¿ mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance. FOR POSITIONS AT GAS STATIONS ONLY: May assist with regular fuel lane maintenance including the handling and cleanup of hazardous materials or substances. Must wear appropriate PPE when required.

Must pass and maintain current fuel safety training as required.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

At Sunrun, we're on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we're building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we're designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It's why we've become the #1 home solar and battery company in America.

We're unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle - from sale through installation and beyond - so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are We're on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs.

Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses. Overview The Field Sales Consultant self-generates sales leads and presents in-home presentations on our solar products and services for potential customers.

Their priority is to make a genuine human connection with the potential customers with the intent to qualify and vet solar as a viable energy solution for their home and families. If you enjoy face to face interaction, engaging customers and find the idea of working out in the field exciting, then this is the job for you!

Responsibilities/The Impact Develop effective self-generated sales strategies, leads and appointments with potential customers Provide an industry leading customer sales experience from initial contact through installation and after the customer's system is turned on Conduct in-home sales presentations for potential customers and evaluate customers' knowledge and needs, building productive long lasting relationships Handle the pipeline of activity from prospect to install by following up with all leads and in-home consultations Accurately disposition and report on outcomes via our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool Meet minimum required sales targets as set by sales leadership Qualifications/How You Will Be Successful Minimum of 1 year of sales and/or lead generation experience, with in-home sales experience preferred Must be 21 years of age, possess a valid driver's license, and maintain a clean driving record with the ability to pass a driving background check Excellent communication and teamwork skills needed to partner cross-functionally when addressing customer needs Willingness to spend time traveling within local market, depending on business needs and sales model Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, to accommodate homeowners' schedules Intermediate comfort level with technology, utilizing an IPAD/computer and multiple software applications.

(experience with a CRM is a plus) How you will be Awarded Full benefits package including health, vision, dental insurance, 401K with company match, Employee Stock Purchase Program, paid training, and much more The opportunity to invest in yourself and your career through PowerU - Sunrun's 100% tuition reimbursement program with over 150 educational opportunities A part of the Freedom Time Off (FTO) Plan - Because of the nature of our business, Sunrun cannot guarantee how much time you will be able to take away from work.

Employees on our Freedom Time Off Plan are not limited to a set number of days that they are entitled to take off from work and instead have the freedom to manage how much time off they need!

Highly competitive sales commissions paid biweekly including eligibility for bonus compensation Competitive salary plus lucrative performance incentives through our Nike/Lululemon sponsored incentive program. You'll have the opportunity to earn Nike/Lululemon swag, prizes and amazing trips. Internal advancement opportunities, as earned.

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel – wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen, inserieren und leasen.

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey

Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly pipeline targets

Job Description
Turnitin is seeking a disciplined, resourceful, and self-driven Sales Development Representative to drive sales growth by strategically prospecting into new accounts and identifying high-quality leads for the sales team.
As the first point of contact for new business prospects, you will be a crucial partner to our account executives. Your role is to develop a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities by conducting market research, executing data-driven campaigns, and developing dynamic territory plans.

You will understand the Turnitin Integrity and Assessment product portfolios to assess potential customers' needs, mitigate objections, and position the right solutions.

You will own the relationship until the prospect is qualified and ready to engage with a sales account executive, allowing them to focus on closing deals while you focus on generating new opportunities.

Lead Qualification & Advancement: Follow up on, qualify, and nurture all assigned leads. Navigate institutional buying processes by mapping key decision-makers and influencers. Skillfully mitigate prospect objections by clarifying concerns and responding with well-prepared solutions.
Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with the sales team to determine the next steps for each prospect. Keep the sales team informed on project statuses, ensuring all relevant CRM systems (like Salesforce.com) are updated in real-time.
Performance & Development: Achieve or exceed all assigned Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Manage detailed prospect account lists, diligently tracking lead progress. Continuously learn and develop your technical, competitive, and sales skills.

Prospect and qualify mid-market opportunities with real estate brokerages and large teams, focusing on deals in the $30K - $250K ACV range.
Run high-quality outbound outreach across phone, email, and social channels to reach brokers, team leads, and executives.
Develop a sharp understanding of how brokerages operate, make technology decisions, and grow their business.
Create qualified meetings for Mid-Market Account Executives with clear discovery and qualification criteria.
Build and maintain your own pipeline from scratch. This role requires a high degree of ownership and self-prospecting.
Track activity, learn from data, and continuously refine your approach to improve conversion.
Work closely with sales leadership to sharpen targeting, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.

1+ years of experience in a lead generation or business development role using phone, email, or social outreach.
Experience prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts. Real estate industry experience is highly preferred.
Familiarity with outbound prospecting tools and CRM systems (Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar).
Strong verbal communication skills with a polished, confident telephone presence.

Attributes
Self-starter who thrives without a playbook. You build your own pipeline and figure out what works.
Persistent and resourceful. You find creative ways to reach decision-makers who are hard to get to.
Curious about real estate and genuinely interested in understanding how brokerages and teams run their businesses.
Comfortable in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where priorities shift and ownership is expected.
Strong project management habits. You stay organized across multiple accounts, channels, and follow-up sequences.

Souhaitez-vous assumer des responsabilités, avoir un impact et façonner la sécurité de l'information de manière globale du point de vue du CISO ?

Chez Netrics, vous travaillez en tant que membre de notre équipe de conseil à l'intersection de la technologie, des affaires et de la gouvernance - proche du client, des décisions stratégiques et avec une réelle marge de manœuvre.

Rejoignez notre équipe de conseil en cybersécurité et accompagnez les entreprises en tant que partenaire expérimenté dans des questions exigeantes de cybersécurité, de risque et de conformité.
## Voici à quoi ressemble votre travail : ##
* En tant que conseiller principal en cybersécurité, vous représentez Netrics de manière compétente et crédible sur le marché.
* Vous conseillez nos clients de manière globale sur des sujets tels que les stratégies de sécurité de l'information, la gouvernance, le risque et la conformité, la protection des données, l'ISMS, le BCM.
* Avec votre expérience, vous assumez des mandats d'interim CISO chez les clients avec des responsabilités stratégiques, organisationnelles et opérationnelles.
* Vous planifiez, dirigez et assumez la responsabilité des évaluations de sécurité, de risque et de conformité, y compris les évaluations de maturité, les analyses des écarts et les recommandations d'action adaptées à la gestion.
* Vous soutenez l'identification des leads ainsi que la création d'offres de conseil en cybersécurité en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et êtes responsable de la mise en œuvre autonome des projets de conseil.
* Vous veillez à ce que les accords contractuels, les normes de qualité ainsi que les exigences d'efficacité soient respectés dans vos mandats clients.
* Au sein de l'équipe de conseil, vous vous impliquez en tant que moteur d'impulsions et d'innovation et favorisez le développement continu de nos services.
* La participation à des événements professionnels et conférences ainsi que la rédaction d'articles spécialisés au nom de Netrics complètent votre champ d'activités.
## Ce que vous devez apporter : ##
* Diplôme en technologies de l'information ou en gestion d'entreprise (université/haute école).
* Plusieurs années d'expérience avérée en tant que CISO, auditeur principal ou dans le domaine de la cybersécurité.
* Expérience de conseil approfondie et compétences stratégiques claires en réflexion et action avec une communication assurée au niveau C-Level et top management.
* Très bonnes connaissances en gouvernance, risque et conformité, protection des données, BCM et gestion des urgences informatiques.
* Connaissances approfondies des normes et cadres courants (ISO 27001, NIST, NIS2, BSI-).
* Des certifications telles que CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC sont un avantage.
* Très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
## Ce qui fait de ce poste votre emploi de rêve : ##
* Vous faites partie de la famille Netrics, une équipe jeune et motivée dans un environnement très dynamique.
* Vous aimez naviguer en hors-bord rapide et participer à la détermination de la trajectoire.
* Des conditions de travail flexibles et modernes vous offrent beaucoup de liberté et de possibilités de création.
* Notre stratégie de croissance vous offre de nombreuses possibilités de développement personnel.
* La confiance et la reconnaissance sont la base de notre collaboration.
* Vous bénéficiez de plusieurs avantages sympas tels que des snacks et boissons gratuits, une allocation pour téléphone portable et une cofinancement de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou de votre place de parking.

Experienced Sales Executive — Fraud Intelligence
Full Cycle Outbound · OEM & Complex Deals · Individual Contributor · US Market
About IPInfo
IPinfo is the market leader in delivering comprehensive and precise IP data, empowering businesses with well-defined data that enables actionable insights. Every day, we process more than 1 billion IP data points, offering an unparalleled big-picture view of the internet.
Our unique approach combines ground truth data with data from ProbeNet, our internet measurement platform, to create a detailed, real-time profile of every IP address. By contextualizing each IP with enriched metadata—covering its origin, connections, and circumstances—we provide businesses with the clarity and intelligence needed to make smarter, faster decisions.
Our data enriches applications and services with accurate IP data that can help manage security risks, improve user experiences, optimize content delivery and ensure regulatory compliance. Join a fast-paced, innovative team that’s passionate about data, technology, and customer success.

We are looking for a talented full-cycle hunter who identifies and pursues high-value targets in fintech and ad tech fraud detection, and owns the complete deal cycle including complex OEM agreements. Key Responsibilities
Full cycle outbound sales
Own the complete sales cycle from cold outreach to close at named target accounts across fintech fraud and ad tech fraud.
Build and manage a list of 50+ high-value market targets with discipline — research, prioritise, sequence, and drive activity.
Generate pipeline at key industry conferences — MRC, Money20/20, TAG, ad:tech — through structured pre-show research, on-floor engagement, and disciplined follow-through.
This is a pure outbound role — backed by full marketing, product positioning, and direct management support, but you are the one driving pipeline and opening strategic accounts.
OEM & complex deal structuring
Structure and negotiate complex OEM commercial frameworks and embedded data agreements within fraud platforms, fintech companies, and ad tech players.
For each OEM opportunity, map where the customer sits in the ecosystem, how IPinfo data propagates through their platform, and what the downstream market opportunity unlocks — stay commercially ambitious while managing deal complexity with precision.
Market & ecosystem intelligence
Map competitive dynamics in your target verticals — who integrates with whom, who competes, where IPinfo displaces or augments the existing stack.
Track emerging fraud vectors and how IP intelligence signals map to them, staying ahead of buyer priorities.
Team & strategy
Collaborate with the Manager of Strategic Markets on account prioritisation and conference planning.
Collaborate with team members on account strategy and share market intelligence accross the team.

Experience
4+ years of full cycle outbound sales — independently opened and closed deals without BDR support.
Closed $100K–$500K ACV deals; OEM or embedded data deal experience strongly preferred.
Consistent quota attainment across multiple years.
US-based or US-focused market coverage.
Proven conference-led pipeline generation.
Skills
Can structure complex OEM deals independently — comfortable with multi-stakeholder commercial negotiations.
Comfortable engaging technical buyers (heads of data, data engineering) and commercial buyers (heads of product, VP Fraud) in the same deal.
CRM proficiency and disciplined pipeline management — accurate forecasting is expected.
Data, API, or intelligence product background preferred; SaaS experience is acceptable.
Personality
Hungry and commercially ambitious — not satisfied with a managed book, wants to build something.
Intellectually curious: genuinely interested in how fraud ecosystems, data stacks, and market dynamics work.
Builds relationships over time, not just transactions — thinks in accounts and multi-year revenue.
Strategic — targets and wins accounts that open new revenue generating verticals as much as the ACV.
Dynamic — drawn to markets at an inflection point, where a better product arriving at the right moment can genuinely shift the competitive order.

A note from Augustin, Manager Strategic Markets
Hi, I’m Augustin, Manager Strategic Markets at IPinfo .
IP intelligence is foundational to how fintech and ad tech companies detect and stop fraud. It is also a market that is in the process of reconsidering its legacy data sources in favour of higher data quality. That creates a significant commercial window for IPinfo , and this team exists to move through it fast.
We will be account-focused, conference-heavy, and commercially relentless. Our mandate is to win the logos that open market verticals, build the case studies that accelerate the next wave of revenue, and influence the overall GTM strategy. It is a challenging role with high visibility and direct commercial impact on IPinfo ’s market strategy.
As a senior member of the team, you will own the full cycle and be expected to operate with autonomy. The deals that matter here are complex: mapping ecosystem position, understanding data flow, and assessing downstream market reach. We need someone who manages that complexity without losing commercial momentum.
We are not prioritising industry experience. Commercial instinct and the ability to hunt are what we are hiring for. The market knowledge comes quickly for the right person. Dokument**Einleitungssatz**
## ##
Unsere versierten Mitarbeitenden in der Betriebsführung steuern die Anlage rund um die Uhr und sorgen für einen störungsfreien Betrieb des Kraftwerks. Nutzen Sie die Gelegenheit und starten Sie bei uns die mehrjährige Ausbildung zum Pikettingenieur.
## **Was Sie erwartet:** ##
* Eine systematische Weiterbildung vom Anlagen- bzw. Reaktoroperateur über den Schichtchef bis zum Pikettingenieur. Die Weiterbildung im Betrieb der Anlage umfasst sowohl fachtechnische Inhalte als auch Führungskompetenzen. Sie findet intern im Ressort Ausbildung und am eigenen Simulator statt sowie extern an der Nukleartechnikerschule in Baden (http://www.kernenergie.ch/).
* Als Pikettingenieur werden Sie vom Schichtleiter zugezogen, wenn das Anlageverhalten vom Normalzustand abweicht und unterstützen situativ mit Ihrer Expertise.
* In Ihrer Funktion als Pikettingenieur nehmen Sie regelmässig an Weiterbildungskursen sowie vielseitigen Simulatorschulungen teil und übernehmen gleichzeitig Verantwortung in einem technischen Fachbereich.
## **Was Sie auszeichnet:** ##
* Sie haben ein Fachhochschulstudium im Bereich Elektro- oder Maschineningenieurwesen oder ein Ingenieurstudium an einer technischen Hochschule erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
* Sie zeichnen sich durch Ihre Bereitschaft zur intensiven Aus- und Weiterbildung aus. Das ideale Einstiegsalter liegt zwischen 25 und 35 Jahren.
* Herausfordernde, neue und wechselnde Situationen bewältigen Sie überlegt, flexibel und fachkundig.
* Sie sind ein Teamplayer, übernehmen aber auch gekonnt den Lead und leiten sowie begleiten Ihr Team in normalen wie auch besonderen Situationen professionell.
* Sie schätzen die Vorzüge der Schichtarbeit (3-Schichtbetrieb) während der Ausbildung und die Bereitschaft zu unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten und Pikettdiensten (inkl. Nacht- und Wochenenddienste).
* Sprachkenntnisse: Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend notwendig, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
## **Was wir bieten:** ##
* Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem etablierten, technisch versierten und verantwortungsbewussten Unternehmen
* Gezielte Förderung von Fachkenntnissen und Kompetenzen
* Marktgerechte Löhne kombiniert mit einem attraktiven Paket an zusätzlichen Leistungen
* Hervorragende Pensionskassenlösungen zur Absicherung der Zukunft
* Genussvolle Verpflegung im firmeneigenen Personalrestaurant
* Ein Arbeitsumfeld, das von gegenseitigem Respekt, Teamgeist und einer offenen Kommunikationskultur geprägt ist.
Sie sind technisch versiert, lieben Herausforderungen und möchten dabei mitwirken, dass alles reibungslos läuft - dann suchen wir genau Sie! Als Pikettingenieur übernehmen Sie Verantwortung und stellen mit Ihrem Fachwissen sowie Ihrem Engagement sicher, dass unsere Anlage rund um die Uhr zuverlässig funktioniert.
Für weitere Auskünfte steht Ihnen Stefan Waldmeier, Leiter Betriebsführung, gerne zur Verfügung.

Notre gamme de services s'étend du référencement naturel au content marketing, en passant par le campaigning, les sites web et les stratégies de marketing digital intégrées. Le plaisir et la passion font partie de notre succès. Cela nous a permis de remporter plusieurs prix lors des "Best of Swiss Web" et des European Search Awards ces dernières années.
## Ce que tu accomplis chez nous ##
Tu prends en charge le conseil et le suivi autonome et à long terme d'un portefeuille client fixe.

*
* Responsabilité stratégique et opérationnelle des campagnes digitales avec un focus sur SEA et Paid Social
*
* Conception, mise en œuvre et optimisation continue des campagnes sur des plateformes telles que Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads et LinkedIn Ads
*
* Développement d'architectures de campagnes, de stratégies de ciblage et de plans médias digitaux
*
* Conseil proactif de nos clients sur les stratégies de campagne, budgets, cibles, canaux et potentiels de croissance
*
* Audits de la performance des campagnes et formulation de recommandations concrètes d'optimisation et d'action
*
* Conception et création de rapports et tableaux de bord pertinents avec des insights clairs
*
* Suivi, contrôle et optimisation continus des budgets de campagne
*
* Gestion de projet autonome incluant le contrôle budgétaire, la facturation et la coordination des parties prenantes internes et externes
*
* Développement des processus, workflows et standards de qualité
*
* Soutien lors des pitchs, acquisition de clients et activités d'auto-marketing professionnel
*
* Collaboration étroite avec nos spécialistes en analytics, programmatique, SEO, UX, contenu et développement web
*
Selon ton expérience et tes intérêts, tu peux assumer des responsabilités supplémentaires dans les domaines du tracking, analytics, publicité programmatique ou gestion de flux et développer ainsi ton profil professionnel chez nous.
## Tu corresponds à notre profil si- ##
*
* tu as au moins deux ans d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du digital campaigning, SEA, Paid Social ou marketing de performance, en agence ou en entreprise
*
* tu maîtrises Google Ads en toute sécurité et as une expérience pratique avec au moins une plateforme Paid Social pertinente comme Meta Ads ou LinkedIn Ads
*
* tu as idéalement aussi de l'expérience avec Microsoft Advertising ou d'autres plateformes de campagne
*
* tu sais penser, planifier et optimiser les campagnes de manière cross-canal
*
* tu ne te contentes pas de gérer les campagnes opérationnellement, mais tu comprends les liens et peux conseiller stratégiquement les clients
*
* tu as une très bonne compréhension analytique et aimes travailler de manière basée sur les données
*
* tu as de l'expérience avec des outils comme Google Ads Editor, Meta Ads Manager, GA4 et Looker Studio ou des solutions comparables
*
* tu sais présenter des résultats complexes de manière compréhensible et convaincante
*
* tu travailles de manière autonome, structurée et précise et aimes prendre des responsabilités
*
* tu abordes les changements de manière proactive et apprécies une mentalité test-and-learn
*
* tu es un joueur d'équipe, apprécies les retours et partages volontiers tes connaissances avec les autres
*
* tu as d'excellentes connaissances en allemand et un bon niveau d'anglais
*
Une expérience avec d'autres plateformes Paid Social, le tracking, l'analytics, la publicité programmatique ou la gestion de flux est un plus apprécié. La connaissance du français ou de l'italien est également un avantage.
Un diplôme d'une école supérieure spécialisée, d'une haute école spécialisée ou d'une université est le bienvenu. Tu peux aussi nous convaincre par une solide expérience pratique et un savoir-faire exceptionnel.
## Ce que nous t'offrons ##
*
* Une équipe jeune et dynamique dans nos nouveaux locaux au House of Impact près de Sihlcity, avec un setup New Work moderne et beaucoup d'espace pour le réseautage et les échanges
*
* Des projets parfois à portée sociétale et des cas passionnants de clients grands et petits
*
* Le travail au sein de Team Farner ouvre des portes vers des sujets inspirants, un large réseau et un savoir-faire complet tout au long de la chaîne de valeur de la communication ainsi que des projets correspondants et des possibilités de développement à long terme
*
* La liberté d'organiser ta journée de travail toi-même
*
* Des hiérarchies plates, une culture ouverte et collégiale ainsi que beaucoup de passion
*
* Des prestations de prévoyance exceptionnelles
*
* Des possibilités de travail flexibles et adaptées aux familles (le télétravail en fait bien sûr partie)
*
* Une académie interne ainsi qu'un soutien à la formation continue
*
* La possibilité de workation
*
* Un délicieux café de torréfaction pour un coup de boost ainsi que notre baby-foot pour des pauses créatives
*

La Fondation Réseau Jeunesse offre un soutien psychosocial itinérant ainsi que (semi-)stationnaire pour les adolescents, les jeunes adultes et les familles. Nos offres sont individuelles, axées sur les besoins et l'efficacité - de l'aide familiale itinérante aux formes d'habitat accompagnées pour jeunes jusqu'aux groupes résidentiels encadrés.
Vous voulez prendre des responsabilités, pas seulement regarder ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit chez nous. Dans « Activation familiale - Équipe jeunesse », vous rencontrez des personnes qui exercent plus qu'un métier - elles montrent de l'engagement, restent présentes et font bouger les choses. Nous accompagnons des jeunes en situations difficiles, qui ne viennent pas chez nous de leur plein gré - mais parfois restent. Nous croyons en ceci : le changement commence là où naît la relation.
Pour notre équipe engagée, nous recherchons des collègues avec des valeurs, du cœur et de la persévérance - qui construisent de véritables relations avec les jeunes, même quand c'est difficile, qui confrontent, réfléchissent et restent présents, qui supportent les situations difficiles. Des joueurs d'équipe avec du cran et de l'humour, qui comprennent l'aide à la jeunesse non pas comme un sprint, mais comme un chemin commun et long.

* Vous ne cherchez pas simplement un emploi - vous aimez le coaching jeunesse et souhaitez travailler avec de jeunes personnes avant qu'elles ne perdent complètement le contact.
* Vous croyez que le comportement peut changer - si la volonté de changer est là.
* Vous travaillez avec cœur, raison et conviction intérieure. Vous n'avez pas besoin de scène - mais vous voulez avoir un impact.
* Vous êtes réfléchi, bien équilibré dans votre propre vie et avez une situation privée qui soutient cette profession.
* Vous êtes flexible, ouvert à la nouveauté, vous n'avez pas peur du changement - car nous sommes en constante évolution.
* Vous vous présentez avec assurance - que vous ayez 25 ou 60 ans - et vous vous considérez comme la carte de visite du Réseau Jeunesse.
* Vous travaillez de manière interdisciplinaire, assumez des responsabilités et êtes plus qu'un simple aide : vous êtes quelqu'un qui croit qu'il est possible de réduire la délinquance - si quelqu'un regarde à temps et reste engagé.

* Flexible, décentralisé - mais toujours connecté
* Notre quotidien professionnel ne se déroule pas au bureau - mais là où vivent les jeunes.
* Nous travaillons de manière mobile, auto-organisée et proche des relations. Nos coachs jeunesse sont en déplacement comme des satellites - autonomes dans la mise en œuvre, mais toujours étroitement connectés en équipe.
* Des formations régulières, des réunions d'équipe et des ateliers de cas favorisent l'échange, le développement et le soutien collégial.
* Au quotidien, nous communiquons simplement - par téléphone, e-mail, WhatsApp ou rencontres spontanées.
* Nos zones d'intervention couvrent non seulement le canton de Zurich, mais aussi les régions voisines comme Lucerne, Zoug, Argovie ou Schwytz.
* Vous n'avez pas besoin de vivre dans le canton de Zurich - ce qui compte, c'est votre volonté d'être en déplacement.
* Conditions d'emploi attractives selon les directives du canton de Zurich.
* Un téléphone professionnel personnel ainsi qu'un temps de travail annuel et une flexibilité dans l'organisation de votre temps de travail.
* Notre travail ne se termine pas toujours à 17 heures et a parfois lieu le week-end.

Looking for opportunities to work for a rapidly growing company? We are looking for call center representatives to support inbound and outbound customer service and sales projects for a wide variety of clients. In this role, you will handle inbound inquiries, troubleshoot basic technical issues, and provide customers with quality product and services. Candidates should have excellent communication skills, willing to learn on the job, and be highly reliable.
There are a wide variety of project openings available representing some of the most recognizable brands in the world. Schedules vary by site and program; however, we can usually find something that works for everyone.
This is an entry-level position that offers on the job paid training. While prior contact center experience isn’t required, experience in customer service, tech support, inside sales or back-office support is a plus. Candidates should be highly reliable, have great communication skills and be willing to constantly learn on the job.

s.h: WHAT DOES A WORK AT HOME CONTACT CENTER REPRESENTATIVE DO?
s.t:
This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience.

In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.
Our entry-level Contact Center Representatives are responsible for the following tasks:
Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues
Utilize systems and technology to complete account management tasks
Recognize sales opportunity and apply sales skills to upgrade
Explain and position the products and processes with customers
Appropriately escalate customer dissatisfaction with managerial team
Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

s.h: WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT?
s.t: MCI provides all new employees with world-class training, so all positive, driven, and confident applicants are encouraged to apply. Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated, energetic, and dedicated.

Must be 18 years of age or older
High school diploma or equivalent
Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills
The ability to type swiftly and accurately (20+ words a minute)
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
Basic understanding of Windows operating system
Highly reliable with the ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality
The ability to evaluate, troubleshoot, and follow-up on customer issues
An aptitude for conflict resolution, problem solving and negotiation
Must be customer service oriented (empathetic, responsive, patient, and conscientious)
Ability to multi-task, stay focused and self-manage
Strong team orientation and customer focus
The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where change and ambiguity prevalent
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with your team and customers

s.h: WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?
s.t: At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

s.h: What You Can Expect from MCI
s.t:
We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:
Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
Health Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for supplemental health coverage through Blue Cross.
Life Insurance: Access life insurance options to safeguard your loved ones.
Supplemental Insurance: Accident and critical illness insurance
Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.
Paid Training: Learn new skills while earning a paycheck.
Fun, Engaging Work Environment: Enjoy a team-oriented culture that fosters collaboration and engagement.
Casual Dress Code: Be comfortable while you work.

s.h: Compensation & Benefits that Fit Your Life
s.t:
MCI takes pride in tailoring our offerings to fit the needs of our diverse team across subsidiaries and locations. While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.
If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!
